chunks: Whatever is in Hāʾ from Dāwūd ibn Abī Zayd, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbdillāh, from Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā ibn ʿUbayd, from Dāwūd ibn Abī Zayd.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father, a transmitter in the chain
key_terms.سَعْدِ بْنِ عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: a narrator in the transmission chain
key_terms.مُحَمَّدِ بْنِ عِيسَى بْنِ عُبَيْدٍ: a narrator in the transmission chain

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Dāwūd ibn Abī Zayd in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Dāwūd ibn Abī Zayd in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. Its significance lies in documenting the chain of transmission and preserving hadith attribution within Shia hadith scholarship.
